items.title: HUD Clutter in Fighter Screen
items.what: The HUD elements (score, round info, and opponent names) at the top of the screen during fights are too prominent and clutter the viewing area.
items.why: On a small portrait phone screen, excessive HUD elements reduce the visible area for the actual game action, making it harder for players to focus on the fighters and their movements.
items.how: Reduce the size and opacity of the HUD elements. Consider using a more compact font and minimizing non-essential information during the fight.

items.title: Control Stick Overlap
items.what: The stance and technique control sticks at the bottom of the screen are too large and close together, leading to potential accidental touches.
items.why: On a phone screen, limited space increases the risk of misinput, which can frustrate players during fast-paced action.
items.how: Resize the control sticks to be smaller and increase the spacing between them. Implement a left-handed layout option in settings for better accessibility.

items.title: Overly Simple Loading Screen
items.what: The ShoeMoney pre-boot loading screen is a static image with no animation or progress indicator.
items.why: Players may perceive the game as unresponsive or crashed if there is no visual feedback during loading, leading to frustration or app restarts.
items.how: Add a subtle animation (e.g., a spinning logo or progress bar) to indicate that the game is loading.

items.title: Low Contrast in Settings Menu
items.what: The settings menu has low contrast between text and background, making it hard to read.
items.why: Poor readability in menus can frustrate players trying to adjust settings, especially in varying lighting conditions.
items.how: Increase the contrast by using a lighter text color or a darker background. Ensure text is legible on small screens.

items.title: Fight Result Screen Delay
items.what: After a fight ends, the result screen (e.g., 'HASANABI WINS') appears abruptly without a smooth transition.
items.why: Abrupt transitions can disrupt the player's immersion and make the game feel less polished.
items.how: Implement a fade-in or slide-in animation for the fight result screen to create a smoother transition.
